lines: {"node_id": "NRS_484B_410_o2", "law_refs": ["NRS-484B-410"], "subject": {"binder": "subject", "class_elements": ["ru.aggregate=DEF-NRS-484A-320::vehicle"]}, "segmentation": [{"id": "s1", "text": "A person,", "role": "subject"}, {"id": "s2", "text": "except when stopping, standing or parking where no parking is permitted,", "role": "exception"}, {"id": "s3", "text": "shall not start a vehicle which is stopped, standing or parked on a highway", "role": "sibling"}, {"id": "s4", "text": "nor enter upon a highway", "role": "obligation"}, {"id": "s5", "text": "unless and until such movement can be made with safety.", "role": "standard"}], "elements": [{"span": "s1", "atoms": ["ru.aggregate=DEF-NRS-484A-320::vehicle"], "derived": [], "justification": "'A person' who enters upon a highway with a vehicle is read through the vehicle's controlled motion (agency reading): the binder is the vehicle, the admitted aggregate DEF-NRS-484A-320::vehicle; same mapping as the index row 'A person'."}, {"span": "s2", "atoms": ["rel.occupies", "st.curb_zone", "dev.regulatory_sign", "dev.governs", "st.travel_region", "prim.conditions_hold"], "derived": ["drv.motion.complete_halt"], "justification": "'stopping, standing or parking' (DEF-NRS-484A-260 'any halting, even momentarily, of a vehicle'; DEF-NRS-484A-250 'the halting of a vehicle'; DEF-NRS-484A-155 'the standing of a vehicle') together denote every halt, drv.motion.complete_halt, read at the observation before the entry. input.old_string: "justification": "A halt in compliance with law is read through the halts a governing device requires: the subject occupies (rel.occupies) an st.travel_region governed (dev.governs, 'the travel regions whose traffic the device controls') by a dev.stop_sign ('regulatory sign requiring a full halt') or by a dev.traffic_signal showing a red indication. dev.governs is not a stand-in for a position: it decides which device controls the region occupied. Same atoms as the index row 'in compliance with law'."}

# Plan — batch 21 (iteration 1)

Eleven nodes for eight law lines. No new concept records: every manoeuvre or state of motion is a
concept already proposed in this iteration (`drv.motion.u_turn`, `drv.motion.complete_halt`). No
law-local aggregate (`aggregates.jsonl` is empty). Two kinds of gap are filed: the atom gap
`ru.disabled` (NRS-484B-440-1, three nodes) and the operator gap for "in compliance with law"
(NRS-484B-450-1a/1c/1e). Those six nodes are not coded until the operator decides the gaps.

## NRS_484B_403_3 — no U-turn in a business district

**Decision.** The act is `drv.motion.u_turn` on the vehicle aggregate. The definition DEF-NRS-484B-077
says "upon a highway", which the concept does not carry, so the rule carries it beside the concept:
`rel.occupies` of an `st.highway`. The index maps "shall not make a U-turn" to the concept alone
(NRS_484B_363_3). Here the defined word adds the highway, so the mapping adds it too. The business
district is the declared assumption `asm.business_district`, read where the act is recognized; the
validator does not let an occasion name an assumption-carried span. The exception "at an
intersection" is read `throughout` the act (the default for an exception). "On a divided highway" is
`rel.occupies` of a highway on which an `st.median_or_divider` lies, also read `throughout`. "Where an
appropriate opening or crossing place exists" is the divider's opening attribute that the footprint
